programs.title: In A Land That No Longer Exists
programs.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programs.title: Vai
programs.desc: Vai is a film about female empowerment telling the story of one woman's life in eight separate moments from the perspective of eight different Pacific Island cultures. Beautifully shot, celebratory and epic, at times heartbreaking and uplifting, Vai is a seamless portmanteau film directed by eight female Pacific directors.

programs.title: Grandpas
programs.desc: Three entrepreneurial grandfathers face an uphill battle when they try to open a day care center.

programs.title: Thunderbirds Are Go
programs.desc: When the launch of a mission to Mars goes awry due to sabotage, International Rescue is requested to assist in the mission's second attempt.

programs.title: Groundhog Day
programs.desc: Bill Murray is at his wry, wisecracking best in this riotous romantic comedy about a weatherman caught in a personal time warp on the worst day of his life. Teamed with a relentlessly cheerful producer and a smart-aleck cameraman, TV weatherman Phil Connors is sent to Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, to cover the annual Groundhog Day festivities.

programs.title: The Full Monty
programs.desc: Six unemployed men from Sheffield decide to become strippers for one night only in a bid to raise extra money. However, with no dancing experience and far from perfect physiques, the men rely on the unique selling point of complete nudity to impress the punters. Comedy, starring Robert Carlyle, Mark Addy, Tom Wilkinson, Hugo Speer and Paul Barber.
